text: このままで　すむと　おもうなよ！

structure.jp: このままで　すむと
structure.en: that it will end as things are

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after a plain verb is a blunt order not to do it. おもうな = 'don't think'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before 'think' shows that the words before it are what is thought. このままで　すむと　おもう = 'think that it will be over just like this'.
